correctness.rationale: For every d≥2, global automorphism averaging preserves feasibility and cannot increase centered operator norm. On the invariant kernel, the tensor eigenspectrum 1−Σ_{i∈S}x_i yields μ=max{1−min_i x_i,Σ_i x_i−1}; capacity is Σ_i(1−1/q_i)x_i≤1. The constrained minimax intersection at θ=min{2/(d+1),1/C} proves the formula and threshold. Independent exact rational checks for seven mixed tuples reproduce all subset eigenvalues, so the mathematical result is correct despite extensive prior coverage.

value.rationale: The main all-dimensional formula, holding threshold and invariant-optimum uniqueness are already mathematically implied by the stronger published d≥3 theorem. The potentially useful d=2 edge-weight comparison is a simple instance of the same two-variable minimax and is not a new, separately scoped and completed theorem in this unmodified final package; correct recomputation and a striking example do not justify presenting the dominated all-d claim as a distinct contribution.
